_doc: Seeed Studio XIAO modules (ESP32-C3/C6/S3, nRF52840, RP2040, RP2350, SAMD21 ...): one size and pinout across the family, so a board can take any of them. kind as in x1c.json.
name: xiao

length.rule: Module length, USB end to far end

pitch.rule: Pitch of the 7 pins down each side

row_spacing.rule: Centre to centre of the two pin rows (0.6 in: the width less one castellation each side)
row_spacing.source: 17.8 mm module less 2 x 1.27 mm. Check against Seeed's KiCad footprint or measure

drill.rule: Hole for a 0.64 mm square header pin

pad.rule: Round pad around a header hole

height.rule: Module above the board it sits on: its board plus the USB-C socket, the tallest part
height.source: USB-C receptacle about 3.2 mm on a 1 mm module board. Measure one

pins.rule: Seen from above, USB at the top: D0 to D6 down the left (pins 1 to 7), D7 to D10, 3V3, GND, 5V up the right (pins 8 to 14). D4 is SDA and D5 SCL on every XIAO
